title: Harness subcommands must be refused anywhere in a worker command
goal: The worker wrapped its rogue finish in a shell, so matching only the command-position binary missed a powershell -Command wrapper around the harness binary and the turn blocked again. Refuse any worker command whose text names a harness-owned subcommand (workflow finish, workflow sync, workflow start, tasks claim, tasks close, tasks release) regardless of wrapper, with tests for the wrapped forms.
